description:
Germany's Cobra 600 drone completed its maiden flight in August 2026, marking a significant step in European defence technology. Developed by Diehl Defence and Polaris, this unmanned aircraft serves as a launch platform for IRIS-T missiles, dramatically extending their range. Simple, recoverable, and affordable, it addresses growing hybrid warfare threats.
